swarm.name: The Spoolwork
swarm.blurb: A roaming network of fibre-bound machines. It sorts, repairs and builds with whatever its damaged instructions can still recognize.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

nodes.label: Anmäl dig till Så vilda! Skåne

creatures.name: Seed Counter
creatures.blurb: It sorts seeds and jams anyone who reaches into its tray.

creatures.name: Moth Camera
creatures.blurb: Its flash calls net carriers. Stop it before the group grows.

creatures.name: Spice Grinder
creatures.blurb: It coats the crew in bitter dust for the other machines to exploit.

creatures.name: Climate Seamstress
creatures.blurb: It pins a moving seam between wet and dry air across the path.

creatures.name: Bed Taxonomist
creatures.blurb: It calls grafting machines to put intruders in their assigned beds.

creatures.name: Garden Warden
creatures.blurb: Its retractable cords guard damaged patrols. Break its cover first.

creatures.name: Guide Frond
creatures.blurb: When cut back, its rooted frame divides into smaller blocking fronds.

creatures.name: Cold Regulator
creatures.blurb: It uses condensation to patch nearby machines. Remove it before they recover.

creatures.name: Walking Scaffold
creatures.blurb: It fences the patrol behind a moving shield. Its jacks are exposed when it braces.

creatures.name: Soil Tester
creatures.blurb: It gathers speed behind a rolling mound of soil. Move before it reaches the crew.

creatures.name: Containment Engine
creatures.blurb: It raises barriers and deploys smaller keepers. Rush its exposed spool.

creatures.name: Curator of Compartments
creatures.blurb: It seals specimens behind shields while its fibre spools sweep the floor. Break the protection and reopen the compartments.

creatures.name: Meadow Guides
creatures.blurb: Pollinators lead the crew between living beds and tend small wounds.

creatures.name: Seed Keeper
creatures.blurb: A keeper shields the crew while moving a cache of regional seed.

events.title: Mixed seed
events.text: A keeper needs the regional seed separated before a counter arrives. The crew can spend supplies or work under the machine’s reach.

options.label: Buy sorting trays
options.result: The keeper saves the seed in separate trays.

options.label: Sort by hand
options.result: The seed is safe, but the counter clips the crew.

events.title: False alarm
events.text: A scrap is drawing the camera toward a resting moth. A decoy costs supplies; a close rescue risks the flash.

options.label: Set a decoy
options.result: The camera follows the decoy away.

options.label: Lift the moth clear
options.result: The moth escapes. The flash catches the crew.

events.title: Harvest
events.text: The bed has food and one metal imitation. Pick through it carefully or sell the whole lot to a passing trader.

options.label: Take food
options.result: Wren sorts a meal from the harvest.

options.label: Sell the harvest
options.result: The trader takes the risk of sorting it.

events.title: Wrong bed
events.text: An inspector is about to remove a plant beside the wrong marker. The crew can use a tool to stop it or sell the tool and take the plant out by hand.

options.label: Use the cutting tool
options.result: Kestrel opens the clamp and keeps the useful technique.

options.label: Sell the tool
options.result: The plant is moved by hand; the trader buys the tool.

events.title: Leaking climates
events.text: A torn screen lets wet air into the dry bed. Supplies can seal it; the wet machinery also has salvage if the crew pulls it free.

options.label: Buy a new screen
options.result: The beds are separated without moving the plants.

options.label: Pull the machinery free
options.result: The leak stops. A live wire bites the crew.

events.title: Hot delivery
events.text: A cart is stranded beside a cordon. The crew can buy a drink or sell the cart owner a spare wheel.

options.label: Buy a drink
options.result: The hot drink gives the crew a rest.

options.label: Sell a wheel
options.result: The cart rolls on and the crew pockets the payment.

story.intro: The swarm has fenced the garden into separate beds. Wren finds living roots behind the barriers. Ox makes a gap for the crew. Kestrel follows a strand of fibre caught on the wire.

chapters.title: Separate beds
chapters.text: Fences divide flowers from their pollinators. The machines guard each bed as if a neighbour were a threat. Ox keeps a path open while Wren checks what still needs water.

chapters.title: Names and origins
chapters.text: The patrols sort plants by family and origin. Kestrel finds the same pale fibre on several sorting arms. It leads away from the beds, though the machines seem intent on keeping everything apart.

chapters.title: Controlled climates
chapters.text: Glass compartments hold plants at different temperatures. The swarm is collecting fibres as it seals them. Wren finds the compartments sound, but their inhabitants cannot reach one another.

story.bossIntro: The Curator closes its glass panels around the last open route. Its spools pull plant fibre through the partitions. Kestrel points to the hinges; Ox raises his shield.
story.outro: The panels fall open. Pollinators cross the beds again. Wren saves a strand from the Curator’s spool. It runs toward a mill, where the swarm is taking the fibre.

site.note: A fan-made game inspired by public pages on mnactec.cat. Not affiliated with or endorsed by National Museum of Science and Technology of Catalonia. All art and text are original.

creatures.name: Pulse Surveyor
creatures.blurb: Its pulse interrupts the crew while heavier machines close in.

creatures.name: Cycle Courier
creatures.blurb: It calls transport drones when it sees movement. Catch it early.

creatures.name: Closure Clock
creatures.blurb: Its shutters close around its own mechanism before it strikes.

creatures.name: Montesa Racer
creatures.blurb: It circles for a charge, then strips useful parts from its target.

creatures.name: Freight Sorter
creatures.blurb: Its hook skims supplies while its crate arms block pursuit.

creatures.name: Conservation Sentinel
creatures.blurb: It wraps damaged allies in protective shells. Break through its cover.

creatures.name: Tour Shepherd
creatures.blurb: It counts intruders and calls small attendants to close the route.

creatures.name: Restoration Hand
creatures.blurb: It repairs damaged swarm units with fibre ligaments. Target it first.

creatures.name: Kiln Caster
creatures.blurb: It dusts the crew and locks them in place for the assembly line.

creatures.name: Wire Loom
creatures.blurb: It reels in wire and sends out small net carriers. Rush the bobbin.

creatures.name: Transfer Beast
creatures.blurb: It changes from rail wheels to treads and charges through shields.

creatures.name: Factory of Futures
creatures.blurb: Its fibre feed braces the assembly line while it produces attendants and sweeps with a long iron beam. Interrupt the supply before the floor fills.

creatures.name: Workshop Restorer
creatures.blurb: A patient restorer removes swarm additions and patches the crew’s tools.

creatures.name: Route Keeper
creatures.blurb: The keeper knows the factory routes and covers the crew at crossings.

events.title: One move
events.text: A strategy machine has left two useful blocks in its game. Keep one as a shield or sell the set to a collector.

options.label: Keep a block
options.result: Ox uses the block to practice a firmer guard.

options.label: Sell the set
options.result: The collector pays for the complete game.

events.title: Sounding the wall
events.text: A pulse reveals a cavity. Repeating it gives time to retrieve the contents but draws a surveyor. Selling the device ends the search.

options.label: Open the cavity
options.result: The crew retrieves a trapped component, but the surveyor strikes.

options.label: Sell the pulse device
options.result: A trader buys it before another pulse sounds.

events.title: Freight mix-up
events.text: One crate holds a motor and the other a live drone. The crane will sell either without opening it.

options.label: Buy the motor crate
options.result: The motor is recovered and the drone remains boxed.

options.label: Open both crates
options.result: The crew finds the motor; the drone clips them on its way out.

events.title: Last lap
events.text: A racer circles a damaged track. Use a spare ramp to stop it or sell the ramp and cross during its next lap.

options.label: Set the ramp
options.result: The racer leaves the track and the crossing clears.

options.label: Sell the ramp
options.result: The crossing is made, with a glancing hit from the racer.

events.title: Closing time
events.text: A repair drone is trapped under descending shutters with a useful part. Hold the shutter or pay a nearby keeper for the spare.

options.label: Hold the shutter
options.result: The drone escapes with the part, but the shutter lands hard.

options.label: Buy the spare
options.result: The keeper supplies the part while the drone takes another route.

events.title: Factory lunch
events.text: A kitchen station offers a hot meal. Another has salvage in its reach. There is time for one before the machines reset.

options.label: Take the meal
options.result: Wren checks the pot and shares the food.

options.label: Take the salvage
options.result: Kestrel pulls loose fittings from the second station.

story.intro: The fibre trail reaches a former mill. Machines draw it through looms and assembly frames. Kestrel expects a nest. Wren finds carefully repaired parts instead.

chapters.title: Raw material
chapters.text: Iron, wire and fibre converge on the production floor. Ox holds off the carriers while Kestrel traces their loads. The swarm seems to be building an army.

chapters.title: Repairs
chapters.text: The finished machines are not all fighters. Some carry water and patch broken units. Wren finds garden fibres used as replacement ligaments. The swarm is trying to keep its own damaged members working.

chapters.title: The missing pattern
chapters.text: Each replacement follows the same incomplete pattern. The looms leave a gap where a control strand should be. A silk collection is marked as the next source of material and instructions.

story.bossIntro: The Factory of Futures draws fibre, iron and salvaged wheels into its frame. It feeds fresh parts to its attendants. Ox braces while Kestrel looks for the supply lines.
story.outro: The factory stops. Among its parts, Wren finds an unfinished body with room for a missing control strand. The swarm is going to the silk museum to complete it.

acts.theme: Silk, memory and a missing maker

creatures.name: Skein Runner
creatures.blurb: It pulls loose supplies toward its exposed reel.

creatures.name: Dye Taster
creatures.blurb: It marks the crew with dye for other machines to exploit.

creatures.name: Negative Stalker
creatures.blurb: Its projected silhouette pins a target long enough for a patrol to arrive.

creatures.name: Hybrid Hatcher
creatures.blurb: Cracking its cocoon releases smaller machines. Be ready for the split.

creatures.name: Anatomy Separator
creatures.blurb: Its fine limbs pin a target for the collection machines.

creatures.name: Loom Mantle
creatures.blurb: It wraps damaged units in layered cloth. Tear through its cover.

creatures.name: Egg-Box Courier
creatures.blurb: Its box hatches mechanical scouts. Stop the courier before they spread.

creatures.name: Mulberry Grazer
creatures.blurb: It turns mulberry leaves into repair pulp for the swarm.

creatures.name: Residency Mimic
creatures.blurb: It copies the crew’s actions behind a shifting thread screen.

creatures.name: Book-Fund Indexer
creatures.blurb: It binds books and marks intruders, then pins them for collection.

creatures.name: Cabinet Architect
creatures.blurb: It guards the station with folding partitions and drives through shields.

creatures.name: Sericulture Station
creatures.blurb: Its feeders mend the swarm as egg boxes hatch and its reel sweeps the floor. Separate the feed and preserve the damaged control strand.

creatures.name: Volunteer Conservator
creatures.blurb: The conservator loosens silk safely and patches damaged equipment.

creatures.name: Station Librarian
creatures.blurb: The librarian protects research notes and helps the crew trace the control strand.

events.title: Hatching cargo
events.text: A courier’s box is beginning to hatch. Cool it with purchased ice or open it before the scouts emerge.

options.label: Buy ice
options.result: The eggs cool and the box can be moved safely.

options.label: Open the box
options.result: The crew stops the scouts, but their sharp legs draw blood.

events.title: Two ends
events.text: Two skeins have knotted around a door. Tracing them teaches a useful motion; cutting them yields saleable fibre.

options.label: Trace the strands
options.result: Wren learns how to shake a binding loose.

options.label: Cut and sell the fibre
options.result: The door opens and a trader buys the short lengths.

events.title: Young tree
events.text: A harvester is returning for a young mulberry. Buy a cart to move it or carry the pot through the patrol.

options.label: Buy a cart
options.result: The tree reaches the nursery with its roots intact.

options.label: Carry the pot
options.result: The tree is safe, but the patrol catches the crew.

events.title: Projected door
events.text: A negative reveals a hidden gap. The crew can keep the lamp to study the projection or sell it and force the cabinet aside.

options.label: Study the light
options.result: Kestrel learns to interrupt a mechanism at the right moment.

options.label: Sell the lamp
options.result: The cabinet moves, and a collector pays for the lamp.

events.title: In the current
events.text: A familiar object drifts in silk and silt. A careful retrieval takes supplies; a quick grab risks the current.

options.label: Use a rope
options.result: The object reaches its keeper without disturbing the other debris.

options.label: Reach into the current
options.result: The object is recovered, but the current pulls the crew against the stones.

events.title: Missing volume
events.text: A librarian has found the rearing notes. The crew can buy a copy or sell a spare book to fund the library’s repairs.

options.label: Buy the copy
options.result: Wren studies a gentler method of repair.

options.label: Sell the spare book
options.result: The librarian pays for a missing volume and puts it back in use.

story.intro: Silk threads run through cabinets, egg boxes and reels. The swarm is collecting records as well as material. Wren compares the unfinished body with a specimen case. The empty slot fits a control strand.

chapters.title: A living supply
chapters.text: The machines harvest mulberry and carry eggs in boxes. Ox protects a young tree while Wren checks the larvae. The swarm is feeding them, not merely stripping the collection.

chapters.title: Threads and records
chapters.text: Skeins carry traces of garden fibre and mill wire. Kestrel finds the same weave in the station records. The missing control strand is a record of a damaged swarm maker, copied into silk.

chapters.title: An incomplete copy
chapters.text: The maker once kept the swarm repaired. Its record is damaged, and the station is trying to copy it by taking whole collections apart. Wren can preserve the surviving strand if Kestrel separates the feed and Ox holds the frame.

story.bossIntro: The Sericulture Station pulls mulberry, eggs and old records into one loom. It is making a replacement for its lost maker, one destructive copy at a time. Its feeders keep the frame repaired. Wren asks for the control strand intact.
story.outro: The station stops. Wren saves the surviving control strand, but it is too damaged to restore the maker. The crew leaves it with the museum’s keepers. The freed swarm units can be repaired without taking the collection apart.
